summary: Education and care for children aged 1-5, organised in barngrupper (Skolverket benchmark 6-12 children aged 1-3, 9-15 aged 4-5; municipal programmes plan for about 18 per group). The law requires suitable group size, a good environment and the premises needed for the education's purpose, but sets no room sizes. Sizes come from municipal programmes: Uppsala uses about 7.0 m² of children's area per child and 8.3-9.3 m² of programme area per child; Malmö plans 15 m² BTA per child; one Göteborg project uses 13.5 m² BTA per child. The decisive constraint is outdoor friyta (PBL 8 kap. 9 §; Boverket guidance 40 m² per child). After that come fire class 5A, ground-floor access for prams and cargo bikes, drainage for many WCs and changing tables, and a large ventilation plant room.

regulatory.bbr_verksamhetsklass_source: BFS 2024:7 (Boverkets föreskrifter och allmänna råd om säkerhet i händelse av brand i byggnader) 2 kap. 18 §: verksamhetsklass 5A covers spaces for people with limited or no ability to get themselves to safety, explicitly naming förskolor. These rules replace the fire rules in BBR section 5. Earlier BBR 5:2 (repealed BBR, pre-2025) also placed förskolor in Vk5A. Fire classes are now in BFS 2024:7 2 kap. 9-20 §§. General fire, egress and travel-distance rules are in cross_cutting.json. Pre-school classes inside a school building are Vk2A/2B (see school_compulsory).

permits: Bygglov for change of use (PBL 9 kap. 15 § 1, from 2025-12-01; the former 9 kap. 2 § 3 a/b is gone; see cross_cutting.json), tested against the detaljplan (förskola normally needs a plan designation for skola/förskola, S) and against PBL 8 kap. 9 § friyta
Anmälan för hälsoskydd to the municipal environment committee (FMH 38 §) before start; municipalities typically ask for plans, child numbers, ventilation and radon data
Registration of the kitchen as a food establishment with the municipal control authority at least two weeks before start (EU 852/2004 art. 6; Livsmedelsverket guidance)
Municipal VA approval of a grease separator if a cooking kitchen is installed (ABVA; SS-EN 1825)
regulatory.operator_oversight: The municipality (huvudman for municipal förskolor, and approving authority for independent ones); Skolinspektionen for state oversight of quality; the municipal miljönämnd for health protection; the municipal livsmedelskontroll for the kitchen

gross_m2_per_unit.source: Malmö stad, 'Friytor vid förskolor och skolor' (Stadsbyggnadsnämnden 2016-08-26, rev. 2021-12-16) p. 10: 15 m² BTA per förskolebarn as a detaljplan estimate. Göteborgs Stad förstudierapport Solvädersbyn/Biskopsgården 103:1 (Förskoleförvaltningen 2024-06-13) p. 4: 108 children, BTA 1 465 m², LOA 1 188 m², 13.5 m² BTA and 11 m² LOA per child. For comparison, Uppsala's 2015 programme gives 8.3-9.3 m² programme area per child, which excludes circulation, walls and technical space (p. 6).

child_area_m2_per_unit.source: Uppsala kommun, 'Program för lokaler i förskola och grundskola F-9' (2015-10-22) p. 6 faktaruta: barnyta 7.0 m² per child, independent of size. Malmö (friyta guideline p. 10) cites miljönämndens vägledning that each child needs at least 7.5 m² vistelseyta indoors.

group_size.source: Skolverket benchmark (riktmärke): 6-12 children per group aged 1-3, 9-15 aged 4-5. It is not legally binding. Skolverket's page 'Rätt till förskola' cites Skolverkets allmänna råd (SKOLFS 2025:440) om styrning och ledning av förskolan with kommentarer p. 11. Actual national average in autumn 2025 was 15.3 children per group (12.5 for groups up to age 3, 16.2 for groups aged 4-5), per Skolverket, 'Barn och personal i förskola hösten 2025', p. 4. Municipal programmes dimension for 18 per group (Uppsala 2015 p. 8; Göteborg project p. 12).

occupancy.typical_unit_size: Uppsala plans sections of 36 children (2 groups of 18) with 6-7 pedagogues, and units of 72/108/144 children (4/6/8 groups). Malmö plans new municipal förskolor for at least 80 children (friyta guideline p. 9).

staff_per_unit.source: National statistic: 5.1 children per full-time post (heltidstjänst) in förskola, autumn 2025. Skolverket, 'Barn och personal i förskola hösten 2025', p. 19. Excludes kitchen, cleaning and admin staff. The Göteborg project (p. 3) lists 25 pedagogues, 2 kitchen staff, 1 cleaner and 1-2 admin for 108 children.

occupancy.opening_hours_note: Uppsala 2015 programme p. 7: premises fully used during opening hours 06.00-18.00. Night-open förskola exists in some areas and changes fire and kitchen requirements.

required.basis: No provision in Skollagen 8 kap. requires meals in förskola (unlike 10 kap. 10 § for grundskola), but meals are universal in practice. Once food is handled, EU 852/2004 hygiene rules and registration apply (law). Uppsala decides the kitchen type per project (2015 programme p. 10).

constraints.grease_separator_required: cooking kitchen: normally yes (municipal ABVA, SS-EN 1825); receiving kitchen: municipality-dependent

spaces.notes: Registration with the municipal food control authority is required at least two weeks before start (EU 852/2004 art. 6; Livsmedelsverket). Kitchens are risk-classified, and cooking for sensitive consumer groups such as small children scores higher. A cooking kitchen needs a kitchen exhaust duct to roof, make-up air, a grease separator and a goods delivery route without reversing. Malmö (p. 11) asks for deliveries to be separated from children's routes in space and time. See variants for the receiving kitchen. Night-open förskola must have kitchen access (Uppsala p. 13).

required.basis: PBL 8 kap. 9 § andra stycket: a tomt with premises for förskola must have sufficiently large friyta suitable for play and outdoor stay, on the tomt or nearby. 8 kap. 10-11 §§ apply this 'i skälig utsträckning' to built tomter and changes needing bygglov. If space is short, friyta takes priority over parking (8 kap. 9 §).

size.count: children; Boverket also says the total friyta should preferably exceed 3 000 m²
size.source: Boverket & Movium, 'Gör plats för barn och unga!' (Boverket rapport 2015:8), faktaruta 10, p. 42: 'Ett rimligt dimensionerande mått utifrån antalet barn kan vara 40 m2 friyta per barn i förskolan'; research suggests total friyta should preferably exceed 3 000 m². BFS 2015:1 itself sets no number. Municipal programmes: Malmö ambition 30 m² per child, minimum 25 m² per child next to a public park, and at least 2 000 m² contiguous on the property (not required for ≤60 children) (Malmö friyta guideline 2021, pp. 9-10). Göteborg project uses 40 m² per child under Göteborg's TKA Mark och utemiljö (project report p. 12).

spaces.shareable_note: Can be opened as neighbourhood play space evenings and weekends.
spaces.notes: This decides most urban office-to-preschool conversions. Boverket (p. 44, citing BFS 2015:1) says that for förskola the friyta should lie at the building, so children need not cross a trafficked street. Roof friyta has limited accessibility and counts as complementary. Malmö requires direct connection to the entrance, with no exceptions, and a plantable deck if the yard is on a roof or over a garage. Noise: Boverket faktaruta 11 (p. 43) says at most 50 dBA equivalent daytime level is desirable on play areas. Malmö uses 50 dBA eq / 70 dBA max. The existing data/standards/space_requirements.json says Boverket points to 'roughly 30 m²/child'. Boverket's figure for förskola is 40; 30 is its grundskola figure and Malmö's förskola figure.

required.basis: Uppsala 2015 programme p. 12 §7.2: the förskolegård shall have space for sleeping outdoors under a roof, wind-sheltered, next to the building and overlooked from e.g. the allrum. Sambandsanalys p. 14 lists 'SOVALTAN' and 'VÄDERSKYDD'.

size.source: No size found

spaces.label_en: Drop-off, cycle and cargo-bike parking, delivery turning

required.basis: PBL 8 kap. 9 § (space for parking, loading and unloading on the tomt or nearby, i skälig utsträckning, with friyta given priority over parking)

size.source: No m² found. Malmö (p. 11) requires cycle parking and disabled parking on the site but outside the friyta, and deliveries without reversing. Uppsala (p. 12) asks that reversing vehicle movements be avoided.

variants.label: Tillagningskök (cooking kitchen)
variants.changes: Uppsala: about 65 m² for 72 children, about 100 m² for 144 children. Needs a kitchen exhaust duct to roof, a grease separator (municipal ABVA; Växjö, for example, requires one above 25 portions/day), goods delivery, cold and dry stores, and kitchen staff changing and WC (AFS 2023:12). Registered food establishment with a higher risk class because it cooks for small children.

variants.label: Mottagningskök (receiving kitchen)
variants.changes: Food is cooked elsewhere and delivered. Smaller area (no size found), still registered as a food establishment, still needs goods delivery and handwashing and washing-up facilities under EU 852/2004 bilaga II. Grease separator depends on the municipality (Årjäng exempts receiving-only kitchens; Växjö and Kristinehamn list mottagningskök). Removes most of the exhaust and grease constraint.

variants.label: Förskola above ground floor
variants.changes: Malmö (p. 9): needs its own entrance with a lift, ground-floor pram and cargo-bike storage, and at least 2 000 m² contiguous friyta in one place. Balconies under 50 m² do not count. Evacuation of Vk5A children from upper floors drives the fire design.

variants.label: Night-open förskola (nattis)
variants.changes: Sleeping children overnight. Boverket's report 'Brandskydd på nattis' notes these fit badly into the occupancy classes. Requires kitchen access (Uppsala p. 13). Treat as a separate fire case.

variants.label: Förskola initially in grundskola premises
variants.changes: Uppsala (pp. 8, 11) designs F-3 school premises so they can host förskola for some years. Skötrum, kapprum and a fenced outdoor area must then be added.

typical_blockers: No friyta on or next to the site. 40 m²/child (Boverket) or 25-30 m²/child (Malmö) plus a contiguous area of 2 000-3 000 m² rarely exists beside an office building.
Upper-floor location: children in Vk5A must be evacuated by staff. Requires lift, ground-floor entrance and a fire strategy.
Deep floor plates: group rooms need daylight and a facade, and the yard should be reachable directly from the group rooms.
Drainage: many small WCs, changing rooms, laundry and kitchen spread across the plan.
Ventilation: a much higher air flow per m² than an office (Uppsala's 72-child unit has a 40 m² plant room).
Noise and air quality on the yard (≤50 dBA eq desirable) at urban office sites.
Detaljplan: an office (K/C) zoning often does not allow förskola (S).
typical_enablers: Ground floor with a direct link to a courtyard or adjacent park (Malmö accepts 25 m²/child next to a park).
Shallow wings with windows on both sides.
Existing office rooms convert easily to staff workrooms, expedition and conversation rooms.
Using a receiving kitchen avoids most of the kitchen exhaust and grease constraints.

open_questions: Fire: BFS 2024:7 (in force 2025-07-01) replaced BBR section 5. Confirm the exact Vk5A requirements (alarm, evacuation, compartmentation) for an upper-floor förskola; general rules are in cross_cutting.json.
Size of a mottagningskök for a förskola: no programme figure found. Uppsala refers to a separate storkök programme that is not public in the reviewed documents.
Uppsala lists the groventré as 40 m² × 1 for 72 children but describes it as shared per 36 children with 40 m² in the illustration. Clarify which applies.
The 7.5 m² indoor vistelseyta per child is cited by Malmö (miljönämndens vägledning) and Luleå. Find the primary source; it is widely attributed to older Socialstyrelsen advice, not re-checked.
Sleeping and rest: no national rule or programme gives a dedicated sleep-room size. Confirm with operators whether project rooms with mattresses are acceptable for 1-2-year-olds.

Does Göteborg have a public standard förskola lokalprogram (Förskoleförvaltningen 'behovsbeskrivning/funktionsprogram' referenced on p. 4 of the project report)? That would give a city-wide norm rather than a single project figure.

Daylight, ventilation and acoustic thresholds are left to cross_cutting.json. The daylight requirement formerly in BBR 6:3 (repealed BBR, pre-2025) now sits in the BFS 2024:x set; see cross_cutting.json.
